parsed.summary: The PR sets a default file upload permission, but it lacks documentation updates and may introduce unexpected behavior.

issues.description: The PR does not update the documentation to reflect the new default permission setting, which could lead to confusion for users.
Setting a default permission of 0o644 may not be appropriate for all systems or use cases, potentially leading to security issues or unexpected behavior.
The PR does not include any tests to verify the new default permission setting, which is crucial for ensuring the change works as intended.
